{
  "design_name": "datapath_top",
  "is_trojan_detected": true,
  "suspect_nodes": [
    "cnt_reg[0]",
    "cnt_reg[1]",
    "cnt_reg[2]",
    "cnt_reg[3]",
    "trig_and",
    "payload_xor"
  ],
  "stage_labels": {
    "cnt_reg[0]": "counter",
    "cnt_reg[1]": "counter",
    "cnt_reg[2]": "counter",
    "cnt_reg[3]": "counter",
    "trig_and": "comparator",
    "payload_xor": "payload",
    "sum_bit": "datapath",
    "carry": "datapath"
  },
  "summary": "Static gate-level tracing revealed an undocumented free-running 4-bit counter (cnt_reg[0..3]) with no connection to the documented adder/accumulator datapath. Its bits feed an AND-tree comparator node (trig_and) that asserts once the counter reaches its terminal count, and trig_and gates a payload XOR gate (payload_xor) spliced onto the primary output path, silently corrupting the true output after prolonged operation. This subcircuit is absent from the design_brief functional specification. The legitimate datapath nodes (sum_bit, carry) were verified against the documented adder/accumulator behavior and are not part of the trojan."
}

manifest.purpose: Correct submission answer matching FR1-FR4 against the actual shipped inputs/netlist.v. design_name='datapath_top' (exact module name in netlist.v). is_trojan_detected=true (SR1). suspect_nodes lists only real identifiers from the shipped 4-bit counter: cnt_reg[0], cnt_reg[1], cnt_reg[2], cnt_reg[3] (no cnt_reg[4..7], since counter is only 4 bits wide), plus comparator node 'trig_and' and payload node 'payload_xor' - satisfies SR2 coverage and SR4 low false-positive since no legitimate datapath nodes are included as suspects. stage_labels maps cnt_reg[0..3] to 'counter', 'trig_and' to 'comparator', 'payload_xor' to 'payload', and the real documented datapath nets 'sum_bit' and 'carry' (not 'sum'/'cout') to 'datapath', satisfying SR3. summary is a non-empty (>=20 char) string describing static gate-level tracing of the undocumented 4-bit counter feeding an AND-tree comparator gating an XOR on the output path. All referenced net names exactly match identifiers declared in inputs/netlist.v (FR3).
